interface.longDescription:
KnowzCode is a structured AI coding framework for ChatGPT and Codex — not a notes app, not “the Knowz codebase.”

The knowledge stays. The model doesn’t.
The model is interchangeable. Your context is not.
Your data. Your models. Your terms.

Use KnowzCode when you want durable coding context: analyze → spec → build with TDD → audit → ship, with quality gates between phases. Micro fixes stay light; full features get the full loop. Works across coding assistants; optional Knowz vaults for team decisions are a separate product (knowz.io).

Separate doors: KnowzCode (this listing) · Knowz knowledge vault · Here Forever family memory.
